Space flight heritage in real conditions and environment is often required to de-risk innovations such as new technologies, products, concepts, architectures, and operations techniques, are they for unique or recurrent, institutional or commercial missions. On 31 March 2023, the European Commission issued a call for expression of interest for IOD/IOV Experiments needing aggregation (available here: https://defence-industry-space.ec.europa.eu/funding-and-grants/calls-proposals/orbit-demonstrationvalidation-20232026_en). The objective is to promote European competitiveness and non-dependence by offering flight opportunities through IOD/IOV for European experiments. The European Commission expects to select a number of experiments that would fly with the Horizon Europe Cassini In-Orbit Demonstration/Validation (IOD/IOV) service. The activity "IHE5-1 Rideshare Opportunities for Experiments needing Aggregation" will result in a number of flight opportunities which will provide the Horizon Europe In-Orbit demonstration/Validation (IOD/IOV) service with a range of flight opportunities to fly IOD/IOV Experiments (selected in the frame of the call above) on-board existing missions. The procurement of Rideshare Opportunities for Experiments needing aggregation will be organized in two steps: Establishment of a pool of European Rideshare Service Providers for the implementation of Rideshare services in the 2024 - 2027 timeframe, through the award of frame contracts to each selected Rideshare Service Provider.
